brief:
Israeli forces demolished homes in the Shejaia neighborhood of Gaza City, the Ma'an news agency reported. The operation came as residents of Deir al-Balah held funerals for victims killed in a recent sandstorm-related collapse.

The demolitions marked a continuation of operations in densely populated areas of Gaza. Details on the number of structures destroyed and displacement resulting from the action were not immediately available.
title: Israeli forces demolish homes in Shejaia as Deir al-Balah buries sandstorm victims
